_comment: Hooks for laravel-plugin. PostToolUse: format the changed PHP file with Laravel Pint. Tries Docker first, falls back to local vendor binary, swallows errors so it never blocks the user.

hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_FILE"; case "$f" in *.php) docker compose exec -T app ./vendor/bin/pint "$f" 2>/dev/null || ./vendor/bin/pint "$f" 2>/dev/null; exit 0;; esac
